steps.eval: (() => { const tr = document.querySelector('#searchResultsTableDiv tbody tr:nth-child(2)'); const name = tr.querySelector('td[data-column=fileName]').textContent; const titles = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mocha .mochaTitle')].map((title) => title.textContent); if (!titles.includes(name) || (document.querySelector('iframe[src*="addtorrent.html"]') === null)) throw new Error(`no download window for ${name}: ${titles.join(', ')}`); if (!tr.classList.contains('selected') || (document.querySelectorAll('#searchResultsTableDiv tr.selected').length !== 1)) throw new Error('the result is not the only selected one'); return titles; })()

(() => { const tr = document.querySelector('#searchResultsTableDiv tbody tr:nth-child(3)'); const menuOpen = document.getElementById('searchResultsTableMenu').classList.contains('visible'); if (!menuOpen || !tr.classList.contains('selected') || (document.querySelectorAll('#searchResultsTableDiv tr.selected').length !== 1)) throw new Error('the menu is not open for the result'); return [menuOpen, document.querySelectorAll('.mocha').length]; })()

(() => { const view = document.getElementById('rssView'); const page = view.dataset.mobilePage; const shown = ['leftRssColumn', 'centerRssColumn', 'rightRssColumn'].filter((id) => document.getElementById(id).offsetHeight > 0); const back = document.getElementById('mobileRssBack').textContent; const title = document.getElementById('mobileRssTitle').textContent; const content = document.getElementById('rssContentView').getBoundingClientRect().height; if ((page !== 'feeds') || (shown.join() !== 'leftRssColumn')) throw new Error(`page ${page}, shown ${shown}, back '${back}', title '${title}'`); const height = document.getElementById('leftRssColumn').getBoundingClientRect().height; if (height < content - 12) throw new Error(`leftRssColumn is ${height}px of ${content}px`); return `${page}: back '${back}', title '${title}'`; })()

steps.js: (() => { const div = document.getElementById('rssArticleTableDiv'); div.scrollTop = div.scrollHeight; window.mobileRssScrollTop = div.scrollTop; })()

steps.eval: (() => { const top = document.getElementById('rssArticleTableDiv').scrollTop; if (Math.abs(top - window.mobileRssScrollTop) > 1) throw new Error(`the articles scrolled from ${window.mobileRssScrollTop} to ${top}`); return `articles kept their scroll position (${top}px)`; })()

(() => { const menu = document.getElementById('rssFeedMenu'); const page = document.getElementById('rssView').dataset.mobilePage; if (!menu.classList.contains('visible') || (page !== 'feeds')) throw new Error(`menu visible: ${menu.classList.contains('visible')}, page ${page}`); return 'long press: menu, still the feeds'; })()

steps.js: fetch('api/v2/search/installPlugin', { method: 'POST', body: new URLSearchParams({ sources: '$REPO/dev/search-plugin/longname.py' }) })

steps.eval: (() => { const div = document.getElementById('searchPluginsTableDiv'); const rows = [...div.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')]; if (rows.length < 2) throw new Error(`${rows.length} plugins`); if (rows.some((tr) => getComputedStyle(tr).display !== 'flex')) throw new Error('not cards'); if (document.getElementById('searchPluginsTableFixedHeaderDiv').checkVisibility()) throw new Error('the header is shown'); if (div.scrollWidth > div.clientWidth) throw new Error(`${div.scrollWidth - div.clientWidth}px wider than the window`); const right = div.getBoundingClientRect().right; for (const tr of rows) { const shown = [...tr.cells].filter((td) => td.checkVisibility()).map((td) => td.dataset.column ?? td.className); const missing = ['fullName', 'version', 'url', 'mobileSwitchCell'].filter((column) => !shown.includes(column)); if (missing.length > 0) throw new Error(`${tr.rowId}: not shown: ${missing.join(', ')}`); if ([...tr.cells].some((td) => td.checkVisibility() && (td.getBoundingClientRect().right > right + 0.5))) throw new Error(`${tr.rowId}: wider than the window`); const button = tr.querySelector('.mobileSwitch'); if (button.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== String(window.qBittorrent.Search.getPlugin(tr.rowId).enabled)) throw new Error(`${tr.rowId}: the switch doesn't show the state`); const box = button.getBoundingClientRect(); if ((box.width < 44) || (box.height < 40)) throw new Error(`${tr.rowId}: the switch is too small to tap (${box.width}x${box.height})`); } return rows.map((tr) => `${tr.rowId}: ${Math.round(tr.getBoundingClientRect().height)}px`); })()

(() => { const checked = document.querySelector('#searchPluginsTableDiv tr[data-row-id="longname"] .mobileSwitch').getAttribute('aria-checked'); if (checked !== 'false') throw new Error(`switch ${checked} right after the tap`); return checked; })()

(() => { const tr = document.querySelector('#searchPluginsTableDiv tr[data-row-id="longname"]'); const checked = tr.querySelector('.mobileSwitch').getAttribute('aria-checked'); if ((checked !== 'false') || !tr.classList.contains('red') || (window.qBittorrent.Search.getPlugin('longname').enabled !== false)) throw new Error(`switch ${checked}, row ${tr.className}, plugin enabled: ${window.qBittorrent.Search.getPlugin('longname').enabled}`); if (tr.classList.contains('selected')) throw new Error('tapping the switch selected the plugin'); return checked; })()

(() => { const tr = document.querySelector('#searchPluginsTableDiv tr[data-row-id="longname"]'); const checked = tr.querySelector('.mobileSwitch').getAttribute('aria-checked'); if ((checked !== 'true') || !tr.classList.contains('green') || (window.qBittorrent.Search.getPlugin('longname').enabled !== true)) throw new Error(`switch ${checked}, row ${tr.className}, plugin enabled: ${window.qBittorrent.Search.getPlugin('longname').enabled}`); if (tr.classList.contains('selected')) throw new Error('tapping the switch selected the plugin'); return checked; })()
(() => { if (!document.getElementById('searchPluginsTableMenu').classList.contains('visible')) throw new Error('no menu after a long press'); return true; })()
